items.description: JAN3 CEO Samson Mow offered to join Nvidia’s board and urged the chipmaker to buy bitcoin, citing about $29 billion in cash holdings. items.title: A year after buying bitcoin, Czech central bank won't say what it's worth
items.description: The Czech National Bank bought bitcoin a year ago as an experiment. The coin has fallen at least 40% since, and the bank's audited accounts carry it at cost rather than market value. The CNB told CoinDesk an outside custodian holds the coins.
